# Radical Possibility™ Mental Health Counseling, PLLC

> Telehealth therapy for women in New York State navigating pregnancy loss, stillbirth, TFMR (termination for medical reasons), infertility, IVF, traumatic birth, and NICU trauma. Founded by Francesca Walker, LMHC-D, NCC, a New York licensed mental health counselor who uses EMDR and Internal Family Systems (IFS).

## Key facts

- Therapist: Francesca Walker, LMHC-D, NCC. New York State License with Diagnostic Privilege #016636. National Certified Counselor #1743343.
- Specialty: reproductive mental health. Miscarriage (including missed miscarriage, chemical pregnancy and recurrent pregnancy loss), stillbirth and neonatal death, TFMR, infertility and failed IVF cycles or transfers, secondary infertility, traumatic birth and birth injury, NICU stays, carrying a pregnancy after a life-limiting diagnosis, grief after abortion or an adoption decision, and pregnancy after loss.
- Approaches: EMDR and Internal Family Systems (IFS), plus Narrative Therapy and Liberation Psychology. Her own method is the Careful Confrontation™ Method.
- Who: women, individual therapy only (no couples therapy).
- Where: telehealth only, for clients physically located in New York State at the time of each session.
- Fees: $500 per 55-minute weekly session, private pay. A monthly superbill is provided for out-of-network insurance reimbursement. She does not take insurance directly.
- First step: a complimentary 15-minute consultation, booked online at https://francesca-walker5494.clientsecure.me
- Outside New York: Postpartum Support International (postpartum.net, helpline 800-944-4773) offers support groups and a provider directory.
- In crisis: call or text 988, or call 911.
